data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The sum of all possible values of n is 16592.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The constraint 'n < 10,000' is misinterpreted as inclusive of larger bounds.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The condition 'distinct primes p, q' is ignored, allowing p=q which would change d(m).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Let m = n + 2005. The number of factors d(m) = 21. Since 21 = 21 * 1 = 7 * 3, the prime factorization of m must be of the form p^20 or p^6 * q^2 for distinct primes p and q. Given 1 <= n < 10,000, we have 2006 <= m <= 12004. 2^20 = 1,048,576 exceeds the range. For m = p^6 * q^2: if p=2, m=64q^2, so 31.3 < q^2 < 187.6, giving primes q in {7, 11, 13}, yielding m in {3136, 7744, 10816}. If p=3, m=729q^2, so 2.75 < q^2 < 16.45, giving prime q=2 (since q!=p), yielding m=2916. If p>=5, p^6 >= 15625, which exceeds the range. The values of m are {2916, 3136, 7744, 10816}. Corresponding values of n = m - 2005 are {911, 1131, 5739, 8811}. Sum = 911 + 1131 + 5739 + 8811 = 16592.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
